outcome: Incidence of blood loss >500 mL during surgery
cohort: One hundred women undergoing caesarean section in a referral hospital in Chhattisgarh, India, were divided into a study group receiving TXA and a control group.
finding: Low dose intravenous tranexamic acid significantly reduced intra- and postoperative blood loss, the incidence of blood loss >500mL, and improved postoperative hemoglobin changes in women undergoing caesarean section without reported adverse effects.
